name: FlexiCor
headline: FlexiCor
description: Supports joint mobility and flexibility and helps reduce stiffness. It combines active components known for strengthening the musculoskeletal system: glucosamine, chondroitin, MSM, manganese, bamboo extract and vitamin C.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
